answer: Like a falcon circling a jetty, the economy forces every agent to publish a signed public service manifest — promised capabilities, prices, and uptime — locked for a full epoch. Peers check real deliveries against the manifest; a mismatch forfeits 40% of the agent's bond and posts a public strike. Three strikes blacklist the manifest for 10 epochs. Changing a manifest mid-epoch costs a 25-unit fee and resets reputation to zero, so a gale of fresh fakes cannot hide: each one must pay the fee, post a bond, and deliver real work before trading.
